user.title: Bible Verse of the Day
user.description: Enter your App Key. Create a free developer account and register an application at https://developers.youversion.com to get one, then pick the language you want Bible versions listed in. You'll pick the version(s) to track on the next screen -- you only enter the App Key here, once.

select.title: Bible version(s)
select.description: Choose one or more Bible versions to track. The list shows the versions enabled for your App Key in the selected language. Each version becomes its own device with its own Verse of the Day sensor. You can add or remove versions later from this integration's Configure button, without re-entering the App Key.

reauth_confirm.title: New App Key needed
reauth_confirm.description: The Bible API no longer accepts the App Key stored for this entry. Enter a valid App Key from https://developers.youversion.com. Your tracked versions are kept.

error.forbidden: The App Key was recognized but is not allowed to list Bibles. Check on the developer portal that the app is active and that you accepted the license of at least one Bible version.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests for this App Key right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Bible API.
error.no_versions: No Bible versions were returned for this App Key and language. Try a different language code, or enable more Bibles for your app on the developer portal.
error.no_selection: Pick at least one Bible version.
error.version_in_use: One of the selected versions is already tracked by another entry. Remove it there first, or pick a different version here.

abort.already_configured: This App Key is already configured. Use that entry's Configure button to add more versions.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this App Key is already in progress.

init.title: Bible Verse of the Day
init.description: Add, remove, or change the Bible versions (and language) tracked by this entry. The App Key stays the same -- no need to re-enter it.
